description: This file contains functions and interfaces for checking user blocking status based on watchlist and lock status, including batch processing and utility functions.

classes.name: BlockableUser
classes.description: Minimal user shape required for blocking checks, requiring email and locked status.

classes.name: BlockingInfo
classes.description: Information about whether a user is blocked and the reason ('locked' or 'watchlist').

classes.name: CheckUserBlockingResult
classes.description: Result object containing a map of email to blocking info and counts of blocked, locked, and watchlist-blocked users.

methods.name: checkWatchlistBlocking
methods.description: Checks if emails are blocked via watchlist, considering global and organization-specific blocking, with fail-open error handling.

methods.name: getBlockedUsersMap
methods.description: Checks which users are blocked based on lock status and watchlist, returning detailed info and counts.

methods.name: isUserBlocked
methods.description: Utility to determine if a specific email is blocked based on the blocking map.
